name: comp-387
title: Share Link Popover
description: A Share button opens a small popover with a row of icon buttons for embed, X, Facebook and email, above a read-only link field with a copy button.
use: A page needs a quick way to share or copy its link from a compact control.
avoid: The social buttons only render icons; none of them build a share URL or open a window in this code.
a11y: Every icon button and the copy control have aria-labels and focus rings; the copied confirmation is visual only. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded popover floats above a small outlined Share button. It centers a bold 'Share code' label over four square outlined icon buttons, then shows a dark read-only field with a grey URL and a copy icon inside its right edge.
behaves: Clicking Share opens the popover. The copy icon writes the link to the clipboard and briefly swaps to a green tick while a tooltip reads 'Copy to clipboard'; clicking outside closes the popover.
customise: The share URL is a fixed default value and the icon buttons have no handlers; making them real means editing the source. Width and colours use tokens.
weight: light: A small popover with four icons and an input; nothing runs until opened.
